title: Grab and OpenAI plan practical AI training for 30,000 partners
friendlyTitle: Grab workers and merchants will learn practical AI skills
summary: Grab and OpenAI launched a two-year program to teach 30,000 drivers, delivery workers and merchants across Southeast Asia practical AI skills. Workshops will cover tasks such as analysing sales, planning promotions, testing business ideas and building simple dashboards or websites.
friendlySummary: Grab and OpenAI will train 30,000 people in Southeast Asia. They will practise using AI for sales, promotions, business ideas, dashboards and simple websites.
whyItMatters: AI adoption becomes more valuable when training starts with decisions people already make at work. This program is a useful model for small-business enablement: hands-on practice, local adaptation and human review of AI output.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Useful training begins with real work, not abstract lessons. Small businesses can learn where AI saves time and where people still need to make the decision.
